all.name: Blade
all.description: Half-human and half-vampire, Eric Brooks walks between worlds, craving the very life force of his enemies. As night falls, Blade's hunt begins as he wields the Sword of Dracula to become the nightmare of any foe who dares to bare their fangs.

item.name: Ancestral Sword
item.description: Slash forward with Blade's Ancestral Sword.

additional_fields.Damage: Cause 26 damage per single slash; double strike cause 13 damage per hit

item.name: Hunter's Shotgun
item.description: Fire at enemies using your Shotgun.

additional_fields.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory, which breaks into shrapnel after reaching a certain distance
additional_fields.Shrapnel_Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 15m, decreasing to 50% at 30m

item.name: Daywalker Dash
item.description: Dash forward. If wielding your gun, shoot at enemies upon impact, applying a <Debuff>Slow</> effect. If wielding your sword, deliver a cleaving strike that inflicts <Debuff>Healing Reduction</>.

additional_fields.Casting: Dash. Cause damage and special effects to the enemies hit
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Hit while wielding the gun, inflict Slow effect to the enemy; hit while wielding the sword, deal Healing Reduction to the enemy
additional_fields.Healing_Reduction_Proportion: apply 8% Healing Reduction per strike (32% total if all hit)

item.name: Stepping Heavy Slash (sword Form)
item.description: Dash forward and slash hit enemies, dealing damage and reducing their movement speed.

item.name: Bloodline Awakening
item.description: Awaken the Dhampir bloodline, enhancing slash speed during continuous attacks and triggering <Orange>Whirlwind Slash</>. If all <Orange>Whirlwind Slash</> strikes hit, your <Buff>Attack Speed</> will further increase. While under this state, you suffer <Debuff>Reduced Healing</>, but attacks gain <Buff>Lifesteal</>. Excess lifesteal converts to <Buff>Bonus Health</>.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Landing all four hits of Whirlwind Slash grants 1 slash speed stack

item.name: Thousand-fold Slash
item.description: Charge power and swiftly draw the Sword of Dracula, executing a powerful Iaido strike as you dash forward, leaving behind a slashing zone where the sword automatically strikes enemies. Enemies hit suffer <Debuff>Reduced Healing</>.

additional_fields.Spell_Field_Range: Length: Maximum dash distance; Width: 6m; Height: 4.5m

item.name: Scarlet Shroud
item.description: Parry with Ancestral Sword to become <Buff>Unstoppable</> for a brief period, reducing damage taken from the front and decreasing the cooldown of <Orange>Daywalker Dash</>.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Every 200 damage resisted grants 1 charge for Daywalker Dash

item.name: New Moon
item.description: Cloak & Dagger share light and dark energy with Hawkeye and Psylocke. When Hawkeye uses <Orange>Crescent Slash</>, he also releases a blade wave that heals and <Buff>boosts healing</> for teammates, while inflicting damage and <Debuff>Vulnerability</> on enemies. Psylocke can launch a Light Boomerang Dart that heals allies, harms enemies, and provides her with temporary healing upon return. She can also unleash a ring of Dark Darts that slow enemies while she briefly enters a <Buff>Phased</> state.

item.name: Eclipse Edge
item.description: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his <Orange>Ancestral Sword</> in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a <Orange>Darkmoon Blade</> forward. When a <Orange>Darkmoon Blade</> hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.

item.name: Darkmoon Blades Fired
item.description: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his <Orange>Ancestral Sword</> in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a <Orange>Darkmoon Blade</> forward. When a <Orange>Darkmoon Blade</> hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.
